messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — for the SF offsite next month: who's planning to fly vs. take the train? Also wondering if People Ops will reimburse carbon offsets for flights?
Maya Patel: Train for me if the schedule works. slower but no plastic cup drama :)
Devon R: Flew last time. Company reimbursed offsets — pinged finance. here's the policy: https://intranet/reports/travel-policy (see 'sustainable travel' section)
people-ops-bot: FYI: Travel policy updated 2025-06-12. Expense note: "reimbursable offsets require receipt"
Sarah J: If anyone's doing Amtrak we could do a group booking and split a carshare from the station to the hotel. cheaper than multiple Ubers.
Alex Chen: Good idea. Quick poll: react with one of these in thread replies: 🟢 for Train, ✈️ for Flight, 🟡 for Hybrid (train one-way), ♻️ to fly + buy offsets. I'll book based on majority and flexibility.
Maya Patel: 🟢
Devon R: ♻️ (I'll buy offsets if I have to fly)
Sarah J: 🟡 (train there, fly back)
Alex Chen: Noted — thanks! If ops can confirm offset reimbursement I'll add a booking window to the calendar.
people-ops-bot: Event 'SF Offsite: Travel Window' added to #people-ops calendar for 2025-08-01 — 2025-08-10
